event Claimed(address indexed token, address indexed account, uint256 amount, uint256 cumulative)
event RoleAdminChanged(bytes32 indexed role, bytes32 indexed previousAdminRole, bytes32 indexed newAdminRole)
event RoleGranted(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender)
event RoleRevoked(bytes32 indexed role, address indexed account, address indexed sender)
event RootPublished(address indexed token, uint256 indexed epoch, bytes32 root)
event Withdrawn(address indexed token, address indexed to, uint256 amount)
function claim(address token, address account, uint256 cumulative, bytes32[] proof) returns (uint256 amount)
function claimed(address token, address account) view returns (uint256)
function hasRole(bytes32 role, address account) view returns (bool)
function leafFor(address account, address token, uint256 cumulative) pure returns (bytes32)
function withdraw(address token, address to, uint256 amount)
